# Fallout 76 - Patch notes August 22, 2023 (Patch 46)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

# FALLOUT 76: PATCH NOTES – AUGUST 22, 2023

Today is our latest update for Fallout 76, bringing with it a brand new season, new skill cards, and much more. Read on to check out the full patch notes for today's update.

## UPDATE VERSION 1.0.85.0

Here you can find out the download size of today's patch on the respective platform:

**PC (Steam):** 2.6 GB
**PC (Microsoft Store):** 11.5 GB
**PlayStation:** 10.9GB
**Xbox:** 11.4GB

## UPDATE HIGHLIGHTS

### CHANGES & NEWS: SKILLS

We've adjusted the level requirements for several existing skill cards to make them easier for low-level characters to use. Plus, you can now open multiple skill card packs at once!

#### NEW SKILLS!

Two new skill cards have been added: “Weapon Wielder” and “Sturdy Tools”!

**Weapon Carrier:** Reduces the weight of all rifles (by 25/50/75 percent per skill card rank).
**Sturdy Tools:** Durability bonus for automatic melee weapons (+10/25/40 percent per skill card rank).
### SEASON 14: FIGHT FOR FREEDOM

Shoulder to shoulder, we march toward America's bright future! This patriotic season brings new C.A.M.P. items, armor paint jobs, and more!

**New Ally:** Grandma Junko's mission is to find her grandchildren...or so she thinks. Even though her memory isn't as reliable anymore, she still manages to serve you hearty, homemade home cooking.
**Presidential Power Armor Paint Designs:** Who needs the Secret Service when you have power armor yourself?
**Oval Office:** Create your own command center with the Oval Office rug and wallpaper.
**Mining Collector:** This new collector will do the dirty work for you when searching for ore!
##### UPCOMING BIRTHDAY EVENT!

On November 14th we celebrate five years of Fallout 76! Dress up in your birthday suit and try our special Birthday Party Challenges to unlock new festive rewards!

**Birthday Party Challenge events take place between November 7th and November 21st.**

## DESIGN CHANGES AND IMPROVEMENTS

##### BALANCING

**Encounters:** We have lowered the enemy difficulty and added additional healing items and ammo to Summersville and Morgantown Airport.
**Encounters:** We have reduced the frequency of NPC attacks on player C.A.M.P.s.
**Encounters:** Legendary creatures will no longer mutate at 50% health to be able to restore health, but will instead gain 60% more health.
**Encounters:** We have made various adjustments to the health, resistances, and weapon damage for the following creatures: Super Mutant, Protector, Mole Rat, Mr. Handy/Mr. Gutsy, Wild Ghoul, Scorched, Shining, Aggressotron, Mirelurk King, Mirelurk Crab, Cave Cricket, RAD Scorpion, Angler, Fire Floater, Ice Floater, Fletsch Floater, Mutant Hound, Liberator and Mirelurk Hunter.
**Resistances:** Protection against acid, electricity, and radiation has been adjusted to be more targeted against each type of damage.
##### EVENTS

**Meat Week:** We've added a number of new rewards to Meat Week and Grahm's Merchant Offer. This includes new C.A.M.P. decorative elements, plush toys and much more.
##### GENERAL

**Free Camera:** You can now use a free camera in Photo Mode!
**Crafting:** Fixed a bug that prevented unequipped mods from applying in the default mod view.
